# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

print("Order IDs containing 'TEST':")

# Check for order_ids with 'TEST' in them
print("Order IDs with 'TEST' in them:")
print(df[df['order_id'].str.contains('TEST', case=False, na=False)])"}
